note: Fake money. Results in R = multiples of the risk taken on each trade.

bots.name: Crowd fade
bots.rule: Fade the crowd: OKX long/short ratio at a 30-day extreme, BTC ETH SOL, 1h
bots.passes: 300+ trades, average ≥ +0.05R, and OKX agrees with Binance ≥ 60% of signal hours

bots.name: OI breakout
bots.rule: 24h-high breakout with Hyperliquid open interest up 2%+ in 24h, BTC ETH SOL, long only
bots.passes: 300+ trades and average at least +0.05R better than the bot's own breakouts

bots.name: Whale copy (piling in)
bots.rule: Copy when 2+ top-20 whales pile into the same coin and side within 24h
bots.passes: 500+ trades, 95% range above zero, and mostly NOT repeating the bot's own trades
